name: activate_siren
description: Activate a siren and/or strobe light on a deterrence device. Specify pattern, intensity, colors, and duration. Or use a saved profile name.

profile.description: Name of saved profile to activate (alternative to manual config)

name: add_overlay
description: Add a text overlay to the camera's live video stream. Use format strings like %c for date/time. Max 512 characters.

name: add_privacy_mask
description: Add a privacy mask to cover a sensitive area in the video. Provide polygon coordinates as they appear in the snapshot image — the server automatically converts to sensor coordinates using the camera's detected rotation/orientation. Masks adapt to PTZ changes.

polygon.description: Pixel polygon "x1,y1:x2,y2:x3,y3:x4,y4" as seen in the snapshot image (top-left origin). Use get_snapshot to identify coordinates visually. Minimum 3 points, recommend 4 for rectangles.

display_width.description: Width of the snapshot used to identify coordinates (default: 1920)

display_height.description: Height of the snapshot used to identify coordinates (default: 1080)

name: check_systemready
description: Check if an Axis camera is ready to handle requests. Returns readiness status, uptime in seconds, and boot ID. Useful for polling after a reboot.

timeout.description: Max seconds to wait for readiness (default: 10)

name: configure_mqtt
description: Configure the MQTT client connection on a camera. Once configured and enabled, the camera publishes events directly to the broker — no MCP involvement at runtime.

name: create_stream_profile
description: Create a new video stream profile with specified parameters. Parameters are URL-encoded (e.g. 'resolution=1920x1080&fps=30&videocodec=h264').

name: delete_audio_clip
description: Delete an audio clip from the camera. Accepts clip name (string) or integer ID.

name: disable_mqtt
description: Disable (deactivate) the MQTT client on a camera — disconnects from the broker.

name: discover_apis
description: List all VAPIX APIs supported by an Axis device. Useful for checking what capabilities a camera has before attempting operations.

name: enable_mqtt
description: Enable (activate) the MQTT client on a camera — connects to the configured broker.

name: export_recording
description: Export a recording from the camera's edge storage as a .mkv file. Downloads to the server's /exports/ directory. Use list_recordings first to find recording IDs, and get_recording_info to check file size.

disk_id.description: Disk ID where the recording is stored

name: get_audio_settings
description: Get audio device settings — input/output configuration, gain levels, mute status, and connection types.

name: get_audit_log
description: Read the security audit log from an Axis camera. Shows login events, configuration changes, and other security-relevant actions. Optionally returns only the last N lines.

lines.description: Return only the last N lines. Omit for the full log.

name: get_camera_info
description: Get device information for an Axis camera: model, serial number, firmware version, hardware ID, architecture, etc.

name: get_capture_modes
description: List available video capture modes (resolution + max FPS) for a camera. Shows which mode is currently active.

name: get_clear_view_info
description: Get Clear View service info — available cleaning services (wiper, speed-dry), duration limits, and cooldown times. Only available on cameras with wiper/speed-dry hardware.

name: get_daynight_config
description: Get the day/night (IR-cut filter) configuration for a camera — shift levels, dwell times, auto-tune, and IR-pass filter settings.

name: get_disk_status
description: Get storage disk status for a camera — SD card and network share info including total size, free space, health, filesystem, and lock status.

name: get_geolocation
description: Get the camera's configured GPS coordinates (latitude, longitude), compass heading, and location description text.

name: get_io_ports
description: List all I/O ports on a camera/device with their current states, directions (input/output), and configurations.

name: get_lights
description: List all lights (IR, white, indicator) on a camera with their current state, type, and configuration.

name: get_motion_config
description: Get the current video motion detection (VMD4) configuration, including detection zones, filters, and trigger areas.

name: get_mqtt_config
description: Get MQTT client configuration and connection status — broker address, port, client ID, connection state, and event publication settings.

name: get_ntp_status
description: Get NTP time synchronization status — whether NTP is enabled, sync status, configured servers, time offset, and next sync time.

name: get_orientation
description: Read the camera's physical orientation from its built-in sensor (accelerometer/gyroscope). Returns longitudinal rotation and lateral tilt angles. Not all cameras have this hardware.

name: get_recording_info
description: Get export properties for a specific recording — estimated file size, exact start/stop times, export format. Use before deciding whether to export.

disk_id.description: Disk ID where the recording is stored

name: get_signed_video_status
description: Check whether signed video is enabled on a camera. Signed video cryptographically signs recordings so tampering can be detected. Tries signedvideo.cgi first; falls back to param.cgi on firmware 12.x where the CGI endpoint is absent despite appearing in API discovery. Response includes a 'source' field indicating which path provided the data.

name: get_siren_status
description: Get the current status of siren and strobe light devices. Returns empty if idle, or active siren/light details.

name: get_snapshot
description: Capture a still JPEG image from an Axis camera. Returns the image directly for visual inspection.

name: get_stream_status
description: Get real-time stream diagnostics for a camera — active client count, bitrate (kbps), FPS, resolution, and codec for each stream. Returns an empty list when no streams are active.

name: get_system_log
description: Read the system log from an Axis camera. Useful for diagnostics and troubleshooting. Optionally returns only the last N lines.

lines.description: Return only the last N lines. Omit for the full log.

name: get_temperature
description: Read temperature sensors (CPU, main board, lens, etc.) and heater status from a camera. Returns readings in both Celsius and Fahrenheit.

name: get_time_info
description: Get the camera's current date/time, timezone, and DST status.

name: get_users
description: List all user accounts on a camera with their group memberships (admin, operator, viewer, ptz). Service accounts (stsuser, AxisDeviceMgmt, pfagentvapix) are flagged separately.

name: list_analytics_producers
description: List analytics metadata producers (object detection, motion, etc.) and whether they are enabled per video channel.

name: list_applications
description: List all installed ACAP applications on a camera with their status (Running/Stopped/Idle), license validity, vendor, version, and resources used. Use this to check if analytics apps like VMD, Object Analytics, or Loitering Guard are active.

name: list_audio_clips
description: List audio clips stored on a camera. Returns each clip's integer ID, name, and storage location. Only available on cameras with built-in speaker hardware.

name: list_cameras
description: List all configured Axis cameras with their IDs, names, and capabilities

name: list_guard_tours
description: List all configured guard tours (automated PTZ patrol routes) on a camera, including their presets and running status.

name: list_overlays
description: List all text and image overlays currently on the camera's video stream.

name: list_privacy_masks
description: List all privacy masks on a camera with their pixel coordinates, names, enabled status, and zoom visibility.

name: list_recordings
description: List recordings stored on the camera's edge storage (SD card or network share). Can filter by time range. Returns recording IDs, timestamps, and video/audio info.

disk_id.description: Disk ID to filter (e.g. "SD_DISK", "NetworkShare"). Omit for all.

start_time.description: Filter start time in ISO 8601 UTC (e.g. "2024-01-15T08:00:00Z")

stop_time.description: Filter stop time in ISO 8601 UTC

max_recordings.description: Maximum number of recordings to return (default: 1000)

name: list_stream_profiles
description: List video stream profiles — preset configurations for resolution, codec, FPS, and other streaming parameters.

name.description: Specific profile name to query (omit for all)

name: list_view_areas
description: List all view areas (virtual channels) on a camera. Each view area is a crop of the full sensor mapped to a virtual video channel. Returns geometry (offset + size in pixels), canvas size, and grid alignment constraints.

name: play_audio_clip
description: Trigger playback of an audio clip on the camera's built-in speaker. Accepts clip name (string) or integer ID. Use list_audio_clips to see available clips.

name: poll_events
description: Poll for camera events over WebSocket for a specified duration. Returns a batch of events (motion, I/O changes, tampering, etc.). Useful for checking what's happening on a camera right now.

duration.description: How long to listen for events in seconds (1-30, default 5)

name: ptz_home
description: Return a PTZ camera to its home position.

name: ptz_move
description: Move a PTZ camera to an absolute pan/tilt/zoom position. Pan: -180 to 180 (degrees), Tilt: -180 to 180, Zoom: 1-9999.

pan.description: Pan angle in degrees (-180 to 180). Negative=left, positive=right.

tilt.description: Tilt angle in degrees (-180 to 180). Negative=down, positive=up.

name: ptz_preset
description: Move a PTZ camera to a named preset position.

name: ptz_relative
description: Move a PTZ camera by a relative offset from its current position.

name: ptz_status
description: Get the current pan/tilt/zoom position of a PTZ camera.

name: reboot_camera
description: Reboot an Axis camera. The camera will be unreachable for ~30-60 seconds. Uses firmwaremanagement.cgi (fw 7.40+) with fallback to legacy restart.cgi.

name: remove_overlay
description: Remove an overlay from the camera's video stream by its identity.

name: remove_privacy_mask
description: Remove a privacy mask by name.

name.description: Name of the mask to remove

name: remove_stream_profile
description: Remove a video stream profile by name.

name.description: Name of the profile to remove

name: reset_view_area_geometry
description: Reset a view area's geometry back to its factory default (full canvas).

name: restart_application
description: Restart an ACAP application on a camera. Useful after configuration changes.

package_name.description: Application short name. Use list_applications to find names.

name: set_analytics_producers
description: Enable or disable specific analytics metadata producers per video channel. Pass the producers array with name and channel settings.

producers.description: List of producers to configure. Each: {name: "producer_name", videochannels: [{channel: 0, enabled: true}]}

name: set_audio_settings
description: Update audio device settings — change gain, mute, or input source. Pass the devices array from get_audio_settings with modifications.

devices.description: Array of device settings (structure from get_audio_settings)

name: set_capture_mode
description: Switch a camera to a different capture mode (resolution/FPS). WARNING: Requires camera reboot to take effect.

name: set_daynight_config
description: Configure day/night switching behavior — thresholds for switching between day mode (color) and night mode (IR/B&W).

DayNightShiftLevel.description: Day→Night threshold (0-100, higher = darker before switching)

DayNightDwellTime.description: Seconds to wait before day→night switch (1-600)

NightDayDwellTime.description: Seconds to wait before night→day switch (1-600)

NightFilter.description: Night filter mode: 'irpass' for IR, 'clear' for visible light

name: set_geolocation
description: Set the camera's GPS coordinates and heading. Coordinates are WGS-84 decimal degrees.

name: set_io_port
description: Set the state of a digital output port. Use "closed" to activate (energize relay) or "open" to deactivate.

name: set_motion_config
description: Set video motion detection (VMD4) configuration. Pass the full cameras and profiles arrays as returned by get_motion_config.

name: set_ntp_config
description: Configure NTP time synchronization — enable/disable, set server source (static or DHCP), and configure NTP server addresses.

static_servers.description: List of NTP server addresses (overwrites existing)

name: set_timezone
description: Set the camera's timezone using an IANA timezone name (e.g. "Europe/Stockholm", "America/New_York", "Asia/Tokyo").

name: set_view_area_geometry
description: Set the crop geometry for a view area, digitally repositioning where the camera 'looks' without moving the physical lens. Coordinates must align to the camera's grid (usually 8px). Use list_view_areas first to get the view area ID, canvas size, and grid constraints.

horizontal_offset.description: Left edge in pixels from canvas origin

vertical_offset.description: Top edge in pixels from canvas origin

horizontal_size.description: Width in pixels (must be >= min_size and <= canvas width)

vertical_size.description: Height in pixels (must be >= min_size and <= canvas height)

name: snapshot_all
description: Capture a JPEG snapshot from every configured camera simultaneously. Returns images from all reachable cameras. Useful for a quick overview.

name: start_application
description: Start a stopped ACAP application on a camera.

package_name.description: Application short name (e.g. 'objectanalytics', 'vmd'). Use list_applications to find names.

name: start_clear_view
description: Activate the camera's wiper or speed-dry function to clean the lens. Optional duration in seconds.

duration.description: Duration in seconds (within min/max from service info)

name: start_guard_tour
description: Start a guard tour (automated PTZ patrol). Use tour ID from list_guard_tours (e.g. "G0").

tour_id.description: Guard tour ID (e.g. "G0"). Get from list_guard_tours.

name: status_all
description: Get a quick status summary of all configured cameras — model, firmware, online/offline, and key capabilities.

name: stop_application
description: Stop a running ACAP application on a camera.

package_name.description: Application short name. Use list_applications to find names.

name: stop_audio_clip
description: Stop any currently playing audio clip on the camera.

name: stop_clear_view
description: Stop a running wiper/speed-dry operation (if stoppable).

name: stop_guard_tour
description: Stop a running guard tour.

name: stop_siren
description: Stop all active sirens and lights on a deterrence device.

name: toggle_light
description: Turn a camera light on or off. Use get_lights first to find available light IDs (e.g. "led0").

on.description: true to turn on, false to turn off
